GRADLE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install GRADLE. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

GRADLE_VERSION.description: Specific version of gradle to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GRADLE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading gradle binary or archive artifacts.

GRADLE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying gradle available remote releases.
